'''Jek Porkins''' is a [[Light]] [[Character]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].

Title

ジェック・ポーキンズ

Card Text

操縦する宇宙船の戦闘力に＋２。レッド６を操縦していれば、さらに回避値が＋１され、戦闘運命数を引けない場合に１枚だけ引ける。

Lore

''ヤヴィンの戦いでレッド６を操縦する。掃射攻撃を得意とする。ティアフォン反乱軍前哨基地で、イエローエース中隊に属していた。元はベスティン星系の独立貿易商人。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Jek Porkins. '''Card text:''' Adds 2 to the power of a starship he pilots. If piloting Red 6, its maneuver is increased by 1 and he may draw one battle destiny if unable to draw one. '''Lore:''' Piloted Red 6 in the Battle of Yavin. Specializes in strafing attacks. Served in the Yellow Aces squadron at the Tierfon Rebel Outpost. Formerly an independent trader from the Bestine system. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore explicitly says he was formerly an independent trader. The English says he is a free trader from the Bestine system. The game text expresses the same listed bonuses in different wording.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Jek Porkins]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].

Title

カーベ

Card Text

自分の支配フェイズに、同じ位置にいる相手の武器かアイテムを対象に選ぶ。運命数を引き、運命数＜対象の運命数ならば、盗んだことになる。アイテムならそのまま使え、武器ならば同じ位置にいる戦士に渡す（コスト０で配備する）ことができる。

Lore

''チャドラ・ファンの少女盗賊。マフタックが保護者。奴隷商人にタトゥイーンに捨てられた。ジュリ・ジュースが好物。モス・アイズリーのジャバ・ザ・ハットの別宅を荒らす。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Kabe. '''Card text:''' During your control phase, choose an opponent's weapon or item at the same location as a target. Draw destiny; if it is less than the target's destiny number, it is stolen. An item can be used as it is; a weapon can be handed to a warrior at the same location, deploying it at zero cost. '''Lore:''' A young Chadra-Fan thief whose guardian is Muftak. Abandoned on Tatooine by slavers. Fond of juri juice. Robs Jabba the Hutt's residence in Mos Eisley. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese refers to an opponent's weapon or item at the same location; the English names a weapon or device at the same site. The Japanese lore says Kabe robs Jabba's residence; the English says she once robbed it.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[Kabe]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], p. 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].

Title

2X-3KPR（トゥエックス）

Card Text

「夜間状態」の場合、同じ場所の自分の反乱軍、エイリアンは、すべて戦闘力が＋２される。「水耕ステーション」のカードと同じ場所にあると、さらに耐：損耗＜３を得る。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-2x-3kpr-tooex-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''整備点検用の単純作業ドロイド。各所に配備された警戒センサーや非常灯、電磁フェンスなどを遠隔起動させる。レリモア・ドロイズ社製のサーバント・ドロイド。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' 2X-3KPR (Tooex). '''Card text:''' During night conditions, all your Rebels and aliens at the same location are power +2. At the same location as [[Hydroponics Station|Hydroponics Station]], it also gains immunity to attrition less than 3. '''Lore:''' A simple labor droid used for maintenance and inspection. It remotely activates warning sensors, emergency lights, electromagnetic fences, and similar equipment installed throughout an area. A servant droid manufactured by Lerrimore Droids.

Title

Card Text

オーウェン・ラーズと同じ場所にいるか、水耕ステーションの上にいる場合、没収値に＋２。相手のターンに、ロストデッキへ行った場合、次の自分のターンが終了するまで、ルークの戦闘力に＋３。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-beru-lars-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''オーウェン・ラーズの妻。ルーク・スカイウォーカーの保護者。ルークの帝国アカデミー入学を夫のオーウェンに進言する。ファームの水耕ステーションの管理をしている。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Beru Lars. '''Card text:''' Forfeit +2 when at the same location as [[Owen Lars|Owen Lars]] or at [[Hydroponics Station|Hydroponics Station]]. If she goes to the Lost Pile during your opponent's turn, Luke is power +3 until the end of your next turn. '''Lore:''' [[Owen Lars|Owen Lars]]'s wife and [[Luke Skywalker|Luke Skywalker]]'s guardian. She urges her husband Owen to let Luke enter the Imperial Academy. She manages the farm's hydroponics station.

''ヤヴィンの戦いで、レッド３を操縦する。ルークの幼なじみ。ヘルメットのエンブレムは、ランド・エクリプティック号で反乱を起こし、造船所から盗み出したことの証。''

'''Title:''' Biggs Darklighter. '''Card text:''' A starship he pilots is power +2. If aboard Red 3, also maneuver +1, and he may draw one battle destiny if not able to otherwise. '''Lore:''' Pilots Red 3 at the Battle of Yavin. Luke's childhood friend. The emblem on his helmet marks the mutiny on the Rand Ecliptic and its theft from the shipyards.

Title

C-3PO（シースリーピーオー）

Card Text

Ｃ－３ＰＯのいる位置で、Ｃ－３ＰＯを含むドロイドと反乱軍のペアが一つ組めるごとに合計戦闘力＋２。同じ位置にいるＲ２－Ｄ２の没収値に＋２。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-c-3po-see-threepio-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''サイボット・ギャラクティカ社の３ＰＯは、人間と機械の通訳を務めるドロイドである。６００万種以上の言語に通じ、作動から１１２年が経過。一度もメモリ消去を受けたことがない…ただし、覚えている限りでの話だが。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' C-3PO (See-Threepio). '''Card text:''' At [[C-3PO (See-Threepio)|C-3PO]]'s site, add 2 to total power for each pair consisting of a droid, including [[C-3PO (See-Threepio)|C-3PO]], and a Rebel. [[R2-D2 (Artoo-Detoo)|R2-D2]] is forfeit +2 at the same site. '''Lore:''' Cybot Galactica's 3PO is a droid that interprets between humans and machines. It knows more than six million languages and has been operating for 112 years. It has never had its memory erased, at least as far as it can remember.

ＣＺ－３のいるロケーションか、そこに隣接した位置で、相手が戦闘、フォース消耗を宣言した場合、リアクションとしてそのロケーションにカードを配備できる。配備コストは通常通り支払う。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-cz-3-seezee-three-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

'''Title:''' CZ-3 (Seezee-Three). '''Card text:''' When your opponent declares a battle or Force drain at CZ-3's location or an adjacent site, you may deploy cards to that location as a react. Pay the normal deployment costs. '''Lore:''' A CZ communications droid manufactured by Serv-O-Droid. An older model that remains widely used. It has a built-in comlink and sophisticated scrambling and encryption capabilities.

Choose a target and draw destiny. The attack hits if destiny equals the target's ability. '''Lore:''' Lak Sivrak's drinking companion. A female Florn Lamproid, a hunter who injects poison into prey with a protruding appendage. She is attuned to the Force, with a reputation for being able to alter the flow of time.

All other Gold Squadron pilots at the same site are forfeit +1. '''Lore:''' Jon “Dutch” Vander commanded Gold Squadron at the Battle of Yavin. He flies a Y-wing. Formerly commander of Specter Squadron at Renforra Base, whose emblem is on his helmet.

Notes

The Japanese game text repeats the phrase meaning “at the same site” twice in its final sentence.

'''Lore:''' An Imperial official with access to highly classified military information. After his homeworld Ralltiir was occupied, his conscience led him to resign and flee. Title

助けて下さい、オビ＝ワン・ケノービ

Card Text

どちらかを選ぶ。1：自分の支配する位置にオビ＝ワンがいる時に使う。このターンの間、オビ＝ワンの能力値を好きなだけ減らし、減らした分を、任意のロケーションでの戦闘の合計能力値に足せる。2：戦闘が起こった際、隣接した位置に反乱軍がいれば、1名選んで、リアクションとして戦闘が始まった位置に移動できる。

Lore

''レイアは要請をホログラムに託した。「ケノービ将軍、かつてクローン大戦の際、あなたは我が父に仕えてくださいました。帝国軍と戦うため、再びあなたの力が必要なのです。」''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Help me, Obi-Wan Kenobi. '''Lore:''' Leia entrusted her request to a hologram. ‘General Kenobi, during the Clone Wars you served my father. To fight the Imperial forces, your help is needed again.’ '''Game text:''' Choose one. 1: Use when Obi-Wan is at a location you control. For this turn, you may reduce Obi-Wan's ability by any amount and add the amount reduced to the total ability in battle at any location. 2: When a battle occurs, if a Rebel is at an adjacent location, choose one and move that person as a reaction to the location where the battle began. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The English lore says Leia's father asks Kenobi for help in his struggle; the Japanese says help is needed again to fight the Imperial forces. The English game text refers to a site you control, applying ability toward drawing battle destiny at another location, and ability used this way not being usable again that turn. The Japanese text instead refers to a controlled location, adding the reduction to total ability in battle at any location, and does not state the same restriction. The English second option specifies an adjacent battle site; the Japanese uses location.

''大型艦には、緊急脱出ポッドが搭載されている。水、食料、照明弾、医療品、狩猟用ブラスター、救助ビーコンを装備。Ｒ２－Ｄ２は、脱出の際、ビーコンを止めた。''

Relocate them to any planet site or to one of your capital starships. '''Lore:''' Capital starships carry emergency escape pods, stocked with water, food, flares, medical supplies, a hunting blaster, and a rescue beacon. R2-D2 shut the beacon off during the escape. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese relocates them to a planet site or your capital starship; the English relocates them to any planet site.

Title

いやな予感がするぜ

Card Text

いやな予感がしようとも、戦闘力の合計が相手より少ないロケーションで戦闘を宣言すること。負ければ何も起こらない。勝てば、相手の失うフォースは2倍になる（ハンがいれば3倍になる）。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-91o-Video.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''コーポレート・セクターや、ハット・スペースでの冒険で、ハンは何度も窮地に追い込まれた。そして、今また…''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' I've got a bad feeling about this. '''Card text:''' Even with a bad feeling, initiate a battle at a location where your total power is less than the opponent's. If you lose, nothing happens. If you win, the opponent's Force loss is doubled (tripled if Han is present). '''Lore:''' Han's scrapes in the Corporate Sector and Hutt Space left him in tight spots. And now again… '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese says nothing happens on a loss; the English only doubles or triples battle damage on a win.

Notes

Japanese-language printing of [[I've Got A Bad Feeling About This]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 98. Card Text

場に帝国軍の宇宙船が２隻以上出ていれば、配備コスト－２となる。モッティと同じ星系にいる反乱軍パイロットは、没収値－１となる。モッティが操縦する宇宙船は、戦闘力＋２になる。

Lore

''デス・スターの指揮を任されている帝国宇宙軍司令官。科学技術を過信し、フォースを蔑視する。野心的な帝国軍のリーダー。皇帝の勅命を支持して昇進したが、軍事能力は評価されていない。ベイダーを嫌っている。''

An ambitious Imperial leader. He was promoted for supporting the Emperor's decree, but his military ability is not highly regarded. He dislikes Vader. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore says Motti supported the Emperor's decree, while the English printed lore says he supported the New Order. Title

Card Text

任意の大型艦に配備する。その大型艦が自分の支配する星系にあれば、その同一星系のすべての位置における合計戦闘力が＋１される。

Lore

「他愛なく口を割られたな。ダントゥインは遠すぎて、見せしめには使えぬが、それもよかろう。まもなくお仲間の反乱軍を壊滅してみせますぞ。」

Dantooine is too far away to serve as an example, but never mind. Soon we shall destroy your Rebel friends.” '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese title describes continued bravery rather than charm. Title

タロン・ロール

Card Text

同じ星系にいる宇宙戦闘機を２機（１機は反乱軍、もう１機は帝国軍）選ぶ。各プレイヤーは運命数を引く。運命数と宇宙戦闘機の戦闘力、および回避値を合計し、相手の運命数と宇宙戦闘機の戦闘力の合計と比べる。合計値の低かったほうが即座に宇宙戦闘機を失う。

Lore

宇宙戦闘機の戦闘に革命をもたらした旧共和国の戦術家エイダー・タロンにちなんで名付けられた戦法。速度と照準ロックを保ちながら、旋回する敵機を追い続ける戦法。

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Tallon Roll. '''Card text:''' Choose two starfighters at the same system, one Rebel and one Imperial. Each player draws destiny. Add your destiny, the starfighter's power and its maneuver, and compare that with the opponent's total of destiny and starfighter power. The side with the lower total immediately loses its starfighter. '''Lore:''' A maneuver named after Adar Tallon, the Old Republic tactician who revolutionized starfighter combat. It involves continuing to pursue a turning enemy fighter while maintaining speed and target lock. '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese states the two totals as a comparison, while the original English separately instructs the opponent and the player to calculate them. The Japanese lore describes pursuing an enemy fighter that is turning; the English says that the pursuing fighter rolls and turns.[[:File:Premiere-D-tallonroll-decipher-archive.gif|Tallon Roll original English printed face]].

{{Set infobox |name=Premiere (Japanese) |image=Premiere-Japanese-box.png |publisher=[[Decipher]] / [[Takara]] |era=[[:Category:Decipher sets|Decipher]] (1995–2001) |released=April 1997 |cards=324 (162 Light, 162 Dark) |code=GEMP set 1301 |country=Japan |language=Japanese |next=[[A New Hope (Japanese)]] |related=[[Premiere Limited]] · [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]] }} '''Premiere (Japanese)''' (基本カード) is the Japanese-language edition of [[Premiere Limited]]. [[Takara]] published it in Japan in April 1997 as スターウォーズコレクションカードゲーム. It has 324 black-border cards, 162 Light Side and 162 Dark Side, 108 of each rarity. Decipher and Takara announced the partnership in December 1996. Steve Stanley, Decipher Senior Vice President and General Counsel, visited Tokyo for Takara's introduction of the set. Takara demonstrated it at the Tokyo Toy Show, 19–23 March 1997, at Tokyo Big Sight. The first three days were trade only. The last two days were open to the public. Takara's gameplay demonstrations had standing room only. Hirohisa Satoh, Jr., President of Takara Ltd., hosted the display. Takara pre-sold more than 80 percent of the print run before street date. Takara was translating the Tournament Kit. Japan was placed in the newly created Ord Mantell region on Decipher's tournament locator. A Japanese champion was expected to compete at the [[1997 Decipher World Championship]]. Takara could not ship the Japanese cards outside Japan. The English Limited set is the 1st expansion of Star Wars CCG. This printing translates that 324-card pool. GEMP loads the Japanese faces as set 1301. English-language packs from [[Dagobah Limited|Dagobah]] through [[Endor]] were sold in Japan with a Takara overlabel on the pack. Poor translations led Japanese players to prefer the English-language cards. Takara and Decipher ended the partnership after Japanese Premiere, [[A New Hope (Japanese)|A New Hope]], [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth]], and the two Japanese two-player games. [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]] has a separate Japanese product. Language editions are listed on [[Translations of SWCCG]]. == Packaging == Takara sold 15-card booster packs (MSRP ¥500) in 36-pack boxes. Each pack had 10 commons, 4 uncommons and 1 rare. 60-card starters (MSRP ¥1400) came in 12-deck displays. ２フォース消費して屋内の位置カードに配備する。移動はできない。フォース消費なしで起動できる。運命数を引く。キャラクターなら、運命数－１＞能力値で、シーカーなら運命数＞２で命中する。他の武器でレーザー・グリッドを狙うこともできる。その場合、運命数＞１で命中する。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-319o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''警備兵の緊急信号によって作動するレーザー・システム。警備上の重要地点や監房ブロックの制御室で使用されている。照準はドロイドの操作中枢を転用している。''

Translation of Japanese Text

'''Title:''' Laser Grid. '''Card text:''' Use 2 Force to deploy at an interior site. Cannot move. May fire at no cost. Draw destiny. Hit a character if destiny −1 exceeds ability, or a seeker if destiny exceeds 2. Another weapon may target the laser grid and hit it if destiny exceeds 1. '''Lore:''' A laser system triggered by a guard's emergency signal. Used at important security points and in detention block control rooms. Its targeting system is adapted from a droid control center.

連射式軽ブラスター・ライフル

Card Text

２フォース消費して任意の戦士に配備する。パワー・ドロイドか「融合ジェネレーター供給タンク」がある時のみ、２フォースで起動できる。運命数を引くこと。運命数＋１＞能力値で命中する。ビークルなら運命数＋１＞回避値／装甲値なら命中する。２フォース消費するごとに、何回でも起動できる。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-320o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

Lore

''ブラステック・モデルＴ－２１連射式軽ブラスター。強力で射程も長い。２５発分のエネルギーを内蔵。パワー・ジェネレーターに接続すれば、無限に撃ち続けることができる。''

Card Text

１フォース使用して、未踏査の位置カードの、相手側に配備できる。自分の支配フェイズに、キャラクターと同じようにフォース消費して移動させることができる。ルークまたは能力値＜３のパイロットと同じ場所についたら、そのうち１枚を選んで、ロストさせる。ルーク・シーカーもロストする。[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-321o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].

''軍用リモート。特定の個人や、条件を指定しての追跡をプログラムされている。熱光学センサーできわめて正確に対象を追跡する。宇宙船に潜り込ませることも可能。''

'''Title:''' Luke Seeker. '''Card text:''' Use 1 Force to deploy to your opponent's side of an unoccupied site. During your control phase, you may use Force to move it like a character. '''Lore:''' A military remote programmed to track particular people or pursue targets that meet specified conditions. Thermo-optical sensors let it track a target with great precision.
